---- MODULE GermanControlBenchmarks ----
EXTENDS GermanControlBenchmarksDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
LOCAL MyTLAPS == INSTANCE TLAPS

GermanTypeOK ==
    /\ cache \in [NODE -> {"I", "S", "E"}]
    /\ chan1 \in [NODE -> {"Empty", "ReqS", "ReqE"}]
    /\ chan2 \in [NODE -> {"Empty", "Inv", "GntS", "GntE"}]
    /\ chan3 \in [NODE -> {"Empty", "InvAck"}]
    /\ invSet \subseteq NODE
    /\ shrSet \subseteq NODE
    /\ exGntd \in BOOLEAN
    /\ curCmd \in {"Empty", "ReqS", "ReqE"}
    /\ curPtr \in (NODE \cup {NoNode})

GermanC1 == \A i \in NODE : cache[i] = "E" => shrSet = {i}
GermanC2 == \A i \in NODE : cache[i] = "S" => i \in shrSet
GermanC3 == \A i \in NODE : cache[i] = "E" => exGntd = TRUE
GermanC4 == exGntd = TRUE => \E i \in NODE : shrSet = {i}
GermanC5 == invSet \subseteq shrSet
GermanC8 == \A i \in NODE : chan2[i] = "GntS" => i \in shrSet
GermanC9 == \A i \in NODE : chan2[i] = "GntE" => shrSet = {i}
GermanC10 == \A i \in NODE : chan2[i] = "GntE" => exGntd = TRUE
GermanC13 == \A i \in NODE : chan2[i] = "Inv" => i \notin invSet
GermanC15 == \A i \in NODE : chan3[i] = "InvAck" => i \in shrSet
GermanC17 == \A i \in NODE : chan3[i] = "InvAck" => cache[i] = "I"
GermanC20 == \A i \in NODE : chan2[i] \in {"GntS", "GntE"} => chan3[i] = "Empty"
GermanC27 == \A i \in NODE : chan2[i] = "Inv" => cache[i] \in {"S", "E"}
GermanD1 == \A i \in NODE : chan2[i] = "Inv" => (curCmd = "ReqE" \/ (curCmd = "ReqS" /\ exGntd = TRUE))
GermanD1b == \A i \in NODE : chan3[i] = "InvAck" => (curCmd = "ReqE" \/ (curCmd = "ReqS" /\ exGntd = TRUE))
GermanD3 == \A i \in NODE : i \notin shrSet => cache[i] = "I"
GermanF1 == \A i \in NODE : i \in shrSet /\ cache[i] = "I" => chan2[i] \in {"GntS", "GntE"} \/ chan3[i] = "InvAck"
GermanF3 == \A i \in NODE : i \in invSet => chan3[i] = "Empty"

GermanInd == GermanTypeOK /\ GermanC1 /\ GermanC2 /\ GermanC3 /\ GermanC4 /\ GermanC5 /\ GermanC8 /\ GermanC9 /\ GermanC10 /\ GermanC13 /\ GermanC15 /\ GermanC17 /\ GermanC20 /\ GermanC27 /\ GermanD1 /\ GermanD1b /\ GermanD3 /\ GermanF1 /\ GermanF3

LEMMA GermanInitImpliesInd == Init => GermanInd
PROOF BY MyTLAPS!SMTT("r30") DEF Init, GermanInd, GermanTypeOK, GermanC1, GermanC2, GermanC3, GermanC4, GermanC5, GermanC8, GermanC9, GermanC10, GermanC13, GermanC15, GermanC17, GermanC20, GermanC27, GermanD1, GermanD1b, GermanD3, GermanF1, GermanF3

LEMMA GermanIndPreserved == GermanInd /\ [Next]_vars => GermanInd'
PROOF BY MyTLAPS!SMTT("r30") DEF GermanInd, GermanTypeOK, GermanC1, GermanC2, GermanC3, GermanC4, GermanC5, GermanC8, GermanC9, GermanC10, GermanC13, GermanC15, GermanC17, GermanC20, GermanC27, GermanD1, GermanD1b, GermanD3, GermanF1, GermanF3, Next, SendReq, RecvReq, SendInv, SendInvAck, RecvInvAck, SendGnt, RecvGnt, vars

LEMMA GermanIndImpliesCoherence == GermanInd => Coherence
PROOF BY MyTLAPS!SMTT("r30") DEF GermanInd, GermanTypeOK, GermanC1, GermanC2, GermanC3, GermanC4, GermanC5, GermanC8, GermanC9, GermanC10, GermanC13, GermanC15, GermanC17, GermanC20, GermanC27, GermanD1, GermanD1b, GermanD3, GermanF1, GermanF3, Coherence
\* END AGENT HELPERS

THEOREM Spec => []Coherence
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF tlaplus_examples_GermanProtocol/GermanControlBenchmarks_Coherence.tla
PROOF
<1>1. Init => GermanInd BY GermanInitImpliesInd
<1>2. GermanInd /\ [Next]_vars => GermanInd' BY GermanIndPreserved
<1>3. GermanInd => Coherence BY GermanIndImpliesCoherence
<1>4. Spec => []GermanInd BY <1>1, <1>2, MyTLAPS!PTL DEF Spec, GermanInd, Next, vars
<1>5. QED BY <1>3, <1>4, MyTLAPS!PTL DEF Spec, Coherence
\* END AGENT PROOF tlaplus_examples_GermanProtocol/GermanControlBenchmarks_Coherence.tla
====
